title: How Does Yeast Make Bread?
speaker: Journey to the Microcosmos
zh: 【Journey to the Microcosmos】酵母如何製作麵包？（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: As you wander through the aisles of the grocery store, you might find your attention caught
cues.en: As you wander through the aisles of the grocery store, you might find your attention caught
cues.zh: 當您漫步穿過雜貨店的過道時，您可能會發現自己的注意力被吸引住了

cues.text: on any number of things.
cues.en: on any number of things.
cues.zh: 在任何數量的事情上。

cues.text: Frozen pizza.
cues.en: Frozen pizza.
cues.zh: 冷凍披薩。

cues.text: Cupcakes.
cues.en: Cupcakes.
cues.zh: 紙杯蛋糕。

cues.text: Wine.
cues.en: Wine.
cues.zh: 葡萄酒。

cues.text: And as delicious as all of those things are, we doubt that any of them undergoes as spectacular
cues.en: And as delicious as all of those things are, we doubt that any of them undergoes as spectacular
cues.zh: 儘管所有這些東西都很美味，但我們懷疑它們中的任何一個都會經歷如此壯觀的過程

cues.text: of a transformation as a packet of instant yeast does when you shoot lasers at it.
cues.en: of a transformation as a packet of instant yeast does when you shoot lasers at it.
cues.zh: 當你向一包速溶酵母發射雷射時，它會發生轉變。

cues.text: Because that is not how yeast always looks.
cues.en: Because that is not how yeast always looks.
cues.zh: 因為酵母的外觀並不總是這樣。

cues.text: In the packet, it’s dry and dull.
cues.en: In the packet, it’s dry and dull.
cues.zh: 在包裝中，它又乾又暗。

cues.text: And when you add water and look under a microscope— without any lasers added—
cues.en: And when you add water and look under a microscope— without any lasers added—
cues.zh: 當你加水並在顯微鏡下觀察時——沒有新增任何雷射——

cues.text: yeast are more like stagnant, sturdy, living bubbles.
cues.en: yeast are more like stagnant, sturdy, living bubbles.
cues.zh: 酵母更像是靜止的、堅固的、有生命的氣泡。

cues.text: So what makes yeast shine so bright when hit with a laser?
cues.en: So what makes yeast shine so bright when hit with a laser?
cues.zh: 那麼，是什麼讓酵母在受到雷射照射時發出如此明亮的光芒呢？

cues.text: Well, we will get there.
cues.en: Well, we will get there.
cues.zh: 好吧，我們會到達那裡。

cues.text: But first, let’s talk about the grocery store, and why you can buy a packet full of
cues.en: But first, let’s talk about the grocery store, and why you can buy a packet full of
cues.zh: 但首先，我們來談談雜貨店，以及為什麼你可以買一包東西

cues.text: microbes while you are there.
cues.en: microbes while you are there.
cues.zh: 當你在那裡時微生物。

cues.text: Because that is where James— our master of microscopes, our purveyor of ponds—
cues.en: Because that is where James— our master of microscopes, our purveyor of ponds—
cues.zh: 因為那是詹姆斯——我們的顯微鏡大師、我們的池塘供應商——

cues.text: got these yeast.
cues.en: got these yeast.
cues.zh: 得到了這些酵母。

cues.text: He bought them, in the form of instant yeast that was sitting on the shelf of a supermarket.
cues.en: He bought them, in the form of instant yeast that was sitting on the shelf of a supermarket.
cues.zh: 他以超市貨架上的速溶酵母的形式購買了它們。

cues.text: And that’s because for most of us, yeast is an ingredient.
cues.en: And that’s because for most of us, yeast is an ingredient.
cues.zh: 這是因為對我們大多數人來說，酵母是一種成分。

cues.text: It’s something a recipe calls for, like milk or sugar.
cues.en: It’s something a recipe calls for, like milk or sugar.
cues.zh: 這是食譜所要求的東西，就像牛奶或糖一樣。

cues.text: But yeast is also something much more than an ingredient.
cues.en: But yeast is also something much more than an ingredient.
cues.zh: 但酵母不僅僅是一種成分。

cues.text: It’s more like our ally, a friendly baker on the inside who does so much of the work
cues.en: It’s more like our ally, a friendly baker on the inside who does so much of the work
cues.zh: 它更像是我們的盟友，一個內部友好的麵包師，他做了很多工作

cues.text: for us, as long as we give it a few things in exchange.
cues.en: for us, as long as we give it a few things in exchange.
cues.zh: 對我們來說，只要我們給它一些東西作為交換。

cues.text: When you buy a packet of instant yeast, what you are really buying is a lot of
cues.en: When you buy a packet of instant yeast, what you are really buying is a lot of
cues.zh: 當您購買一包速溶酵母時，您實際上購買的是很多

cues.text: Saccharomyces cerevisiae.
cues.en: Saccharomyces cerevisiae.
cues.zh: 釀酒酵母。

cues.text: That’s the name of the species, and it roughly translates to “sweet fungus of beer”.
cues.en: That’s the name of the species, and it roughly translates to “sweet fungus of beer”.
cues.zh: 這是該物種的名稱，大致翻譯為“啤酒甜真菌”。

cues.text: But it’s known by many other names, like Brewer’s yeast, Baker’s yeast, and budding yeast.
cues.en: But it’s known by many other names, like Brewer’s yeast, Baker’s yeast, and budding yeast.
cues.zh: 但它還有許多其他名稱，如啤酒酵母、麵包酵母和芽殖酵母。

cues.text: But those first two names are a tribute to the role yeast play in helping to make our
cues.en: But those first two names are a tribute to the role yeast play in helping to make our
cues.zh: 但這前兩個名字是對酵母在幫助我們製造酵母中所扮演的角色的致敬。

cues.text: beer, wine, and— what we’re going to focus on today— bread.
cues.en: beer, wine, and— what we’re going to focus on today— bread.
cues.zh: 啤酒、葡萄酒，還有──我們今天要關注的──麵包。

cues.text: If you’ve used instant yeast, you probably conjure up the image of the tiny, brown-ish
cues.en: If you’ve used instant yeast, you probably conjure up the image of the tiny, brown-ish
cues.zh: 如果您使用過速溶酵母，您可能會想到那種微小的、棕色的酵母

cues.text: white granules that fill the packet and froth up when you add water.
cues.en: white granules that fill the packet and froth up when you add water.
cues.zh: 白色顆粒充滿包裝並在加水時起泡。

cues.text: Those granules are full of live yeast that had been dried out for later use, and their
cues.en: Those granules are full of live yeast that had been dried out for later use, and their
cues.zh: 這些顆粒中充滿了已乾燥以備後用的活酵母，它們的

cues.text: small size is important.
cues.en: small size is important.
cues.zh: 小尺寸很重要。

cues.text: It gives each of those minuscule yeast clumps more surface area relative to their volume,
cues.en: It gives each of those minuscule yeast clumps more surface area relative to their volume,
cues.zh: 它為每個微小的酵母團塊提供了相對於其體積更大的表面積，

cues.text: helping them dissolve faster when they are mixed with liquid and hydrated into something
cues.en: helping them dissolve faster when they are mixed with liquid and hydrated into something
cues.zh: 當它們與液體混合並水合成某種東西時幫助它們更快地溶解

cues.text: that looks more like these cells.
cues.en: that looks more like these cells.
cues.zh: 看起來更像這些細胞。

cues.text: James is a master of microscopes, not a baker, so he wasn’t planning to use these yeasts
cues.en: James is a master of microscopes, not a baker, so he wasn’t planning to use these yeasts
cues.zh: 詹姆斯是顯微鏡大師，而不是麵包師，所以他不打算使用這些酵母

cues.text: to make bread.
cues.en: to make bread.
cues.zh: 做麵包。

cues.text: But yeast, of course, helps us make bread using the same basic processes that helps
cues.en: But yeast, of course, helps us make bread using the same basic processes that helps
cues.zh: 但是酵母當然可以幫助我們使用與幫助我們製作麵包相同的基本過程來製作麵包。

cues.text: them survive.
cues.en: them survive.
cues.zh: 他們生存下來。

cues.text: So the steps James took to bring these cells to life can help us see some of the ingredients
cues.en: So the steps James took to bring these cells to life can help us see some of the ingredients
cues.zh: 因此，詹姆斯為使這些細胞復活而採取的步驟可以幫助我們瞭解其中的一些成分

cues.text: and processes that make our favorite loafs possible, starting out with sugar.
cues.en: and processes that make our favorite loafs possible, starting out with sugar.
cues.zh: 以及使我們最喜歡的麵包成為可能的工藝，從糖開始。

cues.text: We often describe the size of microbes as fractions of fractions of millimeters, but
cues.en: We often describe the size of microbes as fractions of fractions of millimeters, but
cues.zh: 我們經常將微生物的大小描述為毫米的幾分之一，但是

cues.text: it can be tough to wrap our minds around what that really means.
cues.en: it can be tough to wrap our minds around what that really means.
cues.zh: 我們很難理解它的真正意義。

cues.text: Looking at these yeast cells dwarfed by a few undissolved grains of sugar helps give
cues.en: Looking at these yeast cells dwarfed by a few undissolved grains of sugar helps give
cues.zh: 觀察這些因一些未溶解的糖粒而變得相形見絀的酵母細胞，有助於瞭解

cues.text: a better sense of scale.
cues.en: a better sense of scale.
cues.zh: 更好的規模感。

cues.text: Just think of how small a grain of sugar is in your hand, and imagine just how much tinier
cues.en: Just think of how small a grain of sugar is in your hand, and imagine just how much tinier
cues.zh: 想像一下你手中的一粒糖有多小，再想像一下還有多小

cues.text: a little yeast must be.
cues.en: a little yeast must be.
cues.zh: 一定有一點酵母。

cues.text: Again, it’s easy to think of sugar and yeast as two ingredients in bread, one added after
cues.en: Again, it’s easy to think of sugar and yeast as two ingredients in bread, one added after
cues.zh: 同樣，人們很容易認為糖和酵母是麵包中的兩種成分，一種是在麵包之後新增的。

cues.text: to make the right bit of chemistry happen.
cues.en: to make the right bit of chemistry happen.
cues.zh: 使正確的化學反應發生。

cues.text: And while that’s true, there’s also a little more going on.
cues.en: And while that’s true, there’s also a little more going on.
cues.zh: 雖然這是事實，但還有更多事情發生。

cues.text: Sugar is like a bribe that helps kickstart our yeast friends into action, giving them
cues.en: Sugar is like a bribe that helps kickstart our yeast friends into action, giving them
cues.zh: 糖就像一種賄賂，可以幫助我們的酵母朋友採取行動，給他們

cues.text: the sustenance they need to get moving.
cues.en: the sustenance they need to get moving.
cues.zh: 他們行動所需的食物。

cues.text: As the yeast feeds, they begin to divide, forming smaller daughter cells that bud off
cues.en: As the yeast feeds, they begin to divide, forming smaller daughter cells that bud off
cues.zh: 當酵母進食時，它們開始分裂，形成更小的子細胞並發芽

cues.text: from their mothers.
cues.en: from their mothers.
cues.zh: 來自他們的母親。

cues.text: You can see some of those buds here, forming ovals that branch off the circular mother cell.
cues.en: You can see some of those buds here, forming ovals that branch off the circular mother cell.
cues.zh: 您可以在這裡看到其中一些芽，形成一個橢圓形，從圓形母細胞分支出來。

cues.text: This is where the name “budding yeast” comes from, and it’s yet another way that
cues.en: This is where the name “budding yeast” comes from, and it’s yet another way that
cues.zh: 這就是「芽殖酵母」這個名字的由來，這是另一種方式

cues.text: yeast is different from our other ingredients.
cues.en: yeast is different from our other ingredients.
cues.zh: 酵母與我們的其他成分不同。

cues.text: Sugar doesn’t make more sugar, but for yeast replication is one of their objectives, driving
cues.en: Sugar doesn’t make more sugar, but for yeast replication is one of their objectives, driving
cues.zh: 糖不會產生更多的糖，但對於酵母來說，複製是它們的目標之一，推動

cues.text: the growth and survival of their population.
cues.en: the growth and survival of their population.
cues.zh: 人口的成長和生存。

cues.text: But as the yeast accomplishes their goals, they happen to get some of our goals done as well.
cues.en: But as the yeast accomplishes their goals, they happen to get some of our goals done as well.
cues.zh: 但當酵母實現它們的目標時，它們也恰好實現了我們的一些目標。

cues.text: As the yeast digests sugar, they produce byproducts: various organic acids, ethanol, and carbon dioxide—
cues.en: As the yeast digests sugar, they produce byproducts: various organic acids, ethanol, and carbon dioxide—
cues.zh: 當酵母消化糖時，它們會產生副產品：各種有機酸、乙醇和二氧化碳—

cues.text: which you can see here in bubbles expanding
cues.en: which you can see here in bubbles expanding
cues.zh: 你可以在這裡看到氣泡膨脹

cues.text: and pushing against the field of yeast.
cues.en: and pushing against the field of yeast.
cues.zh: 並推動酵母領域。

cues.text: We are watching these bubbles grow in water, and over the next few minutes, their edges
cues.en: We are watching these bubbles grow in water, and over the next few minutes, their edges
cues.zh: 我們正在觀察這些氣泡在水中生長，在接下來的幾分鐘內，它們的邊緣

cues.text: will push further and further out until these two bubbles seem to take over the screen.
cues.en: will push further and further out until these two bubbles seem to take over the screen.
cues.zh: 會越來越遠，直到這兩個氣泡似乎佔據了螢幕。

cues.text: But in bread dough, those carbon dioxide bubbles cause the entire structure around the yeast
cues.en: But in bread dough, those carbon dioxide bubbles cause the entire structure around the yeast
cues.zh: 但在麵包麵團中，這些二氧化碳氣泡會導致酵母周圍的整個結構發生變化

cues.text: to expand and to rise.
cues.en: to expand and to rise.
cues.zh: 擴大和上升。

cues.text: And when the dough is moved to the oven, the carbon dioxide will shape the bread that forms.
cues.en: And when the dough is moved to the oven, the carbon dioxide will shape the bread that forms.
cues.zh: 當麵團被移至烤箱時，二氧化碳將使形成的麵包成型。

cues.text: The ethanol byproduct isn’t visible like those carbon dioxide bubbles are, but in bread
cues.en: The ethanol byproduct isn’t visible like those carbon dioxide bubbles are, but in bread
cues.zh: 乙醇副產品不像二氧化碳氣泡那麼可見，但在麵包中

cues.text: dough, the evaporation of ethanol also helps the bread rise in the oven.
cues.en: dough, the evaporation of ethanol also helps the bread rise in the oven.
cues.zh: 麵團中乙醇的蒸發也有助於麵包在烤箱中發酵。

cues.text: And it will also shape the flavor of the bread that comes out.
cues.en: And it will also shape the flavor of the bread that comes out.
cues.zh: 它還會影響麵包的味道。

cues.text: While it is making bread for us, the world inside the yeast is busy as well.
cues.en: While it is making bread for us, the world inside the yeast is busy as well.
cues.zh: 當它為我們製作麵包時，酵母內部的世界也在忙碌。

cues.text: Buried in dough, it’s impossible to see what that means.
cues.en: Buried in dough, it’s impossible to see what that means.
cues.zh: 埋在麵團裡，不可能明白這代表什麼。

cues.text: But microscopes are powerful tools when it comes to digging up seemingly invisible forms
cues.en: But microscopes are powerful tools when it comes to digging up seemingly invisible forms
cues.zh: 但在挖掘看似看不見的物體時，顯微鏡是強大的工具

cues.text: of beauty, especially when they have lasers in them.
cues.en: of beauty, especially when they have lasers in them.
cues.zh: 美麗，尤其是當它們帶有雷射時。

cues.text: With a microscope that sends a laser of UV light straight at the yeast, molecules inside
cues.en: With a microscope that sends a laser of UV light straight at the yeast, molecules inside
cues.zh: 使用顯微鏡將紫外線雷射直接射向酵母，內部分子

cues.text: the organism begin to fluoresce, a display called autofluorescence that lights up the
cues.en: the organism begin to fluoresce, a display called autofluorescence that lights up the
cues.zh: 有機體開始發出螢光，這種顯示稱為自發螢光，照亮了

cues.text: whole screen with rings of red and green and yellow that press up against each other and overlap.
cues.en: whole screen with rings of red and green and yellow that press up against each other and overlap.
cues.zh: 整個螢幕上有紅色、綠色和黃色的環，這些環相互擠壓並重疊。

cues.text: To scientists who know how to crack the code, those colors create a map of the molecules
cues.en: To scientists who know how to crack the code, those colors create a map of the molecules
cues.zh: 對於知道如何破解密碼的科學家來說，這些顏色建立了分子圖

cues.text: inside the cell.
cues.en: inside the cell.
cues.zh: 細胞內。

cues.text: Those colors are actually the amino acids and vitamins that make the yeast work, rising
cues.en: Those colors are actually the amino acids and vitamins that make the yeast work, rising
cues.zh: 這些顏色實際上是氨基酸和維生素，使酵母發揮作用，上升

cues.text: and falling throughout the yeast’s life cycle to provide the organism with what it
cues.en: and falling throughout the yeast’s life cycle to provide the organism with what it
cues.zh: 並在酵母的整個生命週期中為生物體提供它所需要的

cues.text: needs to survive.
cues.en: needs to survive.
cues.zh: 需要生存。

cues.text: It’s as if someone turned on the lights at the factory, illuminating all the processes
cues.en: It’s as if someone turned on the lights at the factory, illuminating all the processes
cues.zh: 就好像有人開啟了工廠的燈，照亮了所有的流程

cues.text: that make the final product possible.
cues.en: that make the final product possible.
cues.zh: 使最終產品成為可能。

cues.text: And if we could dedicate a whole episode to the stunning autofluorescing patterns of yeast,
cues.en: And if we could dedicate a whole episode to the stunning autofluorescing patterns of yeast,
cues.zh: 如果我們能用一整集來展示酵母令人驚嘆的自發螢光模式，

cues.text: we would.
cues.en: we would.
cues.zh: 我們會的。

cues.text: But there is one big challenge.
cues.en: But there is one big challenge.
cues.zh: 但還有一個巨大的挑戰。

cues.text: You may have noticed that the videos we’ve been showing of this are pretty short.
cues.en: You may have noticed that the videos we’ve been showing of this are pretty short.
cues.zh: 您可能已經註意到，我們展示的影片非常短。

cues.text: Most only last a few seconds before we switch to another video.
cues.en: Most only last a few seconds before we switch to another video.
cues.zh: 大多數只持續幾秒鐘，然後我們就會切換到另一個影片。

cues.text: And that is because those bright lights quickly fade after being struck with the laser.
cues.en: And that is because those bright lights quickly fade after being struck with the laser.
cues.zh: 這是因為那些明亮的光在被雷射照射後很快就會消失。

cues.text: Let’s sit here and watch this group of yeast, initially bright red and green.
cues.en: Let’s sit here and watch this group of yeast, initially bright red and green.
cues.zh: 讓我們坐在這裡觀察這組酵母，最初是鮮紅色和綠色的。

cues.text: After only a few seconds, the red is already gone.
cues.en: After only a few seconds, the red is already gone.
cues.zh: 僅僅幾秒鐘後，紅色就消失了。

cues.text: And as more seconds pass, the green becomes more and more faint, like someone has been
cues.en: And as more seconds pass, the green becomes more and more faint, like someone has been
cues.zh: 隨著時間的流逝，綠色變得越來越淡，就像有人已經

cues.text: turning the brightness on your screen down at an agonizingly slow pace.
cues.en: turning the brightness on your screen down at an agonizingly slow pace.
cues.zh: 以極為緩慢的速度調低螢幕亮度。

cues.text: After a full minute, the screen has gone completely black, with no hint at the vivid scene painted
cues.en: After a full minute, the screen has gone completely black, with no hint at the vivid scene painted
cues.zh: 整整一分鐘後，螢幕完全黑了，看不到描繪的生動場景。

cues.text: across it so recently— almost as if it had never been there to begin with.
cues.en: across it so recently— almost as if it had never been there to begin with.
cues.zh: 最近才穿過它——幾乎就好像它從來沒有存在過一樣。

cues.text: But even as the lights fade, the factory remains.
cues.en: But even as the lights fade, the factory remains.
cues.zh: 但即使燈光褪去，工廠依然存在。

cues.text: Every day, perhaps in your kitchen or in the bakery around the corner from you, there is
cues.en: Every day, perhaps in your kitchen or in the bakery around the corner from you, there is
cues.zh: 每天，也許在您的廚房或您附近的麵包店裡，都有

cues.text: a group of invisible budding bakers occupied with turning sugar into carbon dioxide and ethanol.
cues.en: a group of invisible budding bakers occupied with turning sugar into carbon dioxide and ethanol.
cues.zh: 一群看不見的嶄露頭角的麵包師致力於將糖轉化為二氧化碳和乙醇。

cues.text: However transient their lives or their work, the legacy they leave…well,
